implementation_mapping_to_verified_core.base: examples/ascend/flash_attention/core.py (verified numerically on this silicon before any modification)
implementation_mapping_to_verified_core.correspondence: 1:1 macro sequence inside ONE T.Kernel: qk -> softmax -> pack_p -> pv -> accumulate_output -> finalize. The mixed kernel IS that sequence; it is not a lookalike.
extensions_beyond_base: in_dtype parameter: the base hardcodes dtype='bfloat16'. FP16 support required parameterising dtype plus the 5 S.vcvt calls and 2 T.reinterpret calls that named bf16 explicitly. That is the entire FP16 extension.
kv_mask parameter: an additive bias buffer added to the scaled scores BEFORE the row max, so padded KV columns contribute exactly 0 to exp and to l.
all-invalid-row guards (two, both required, see nan_guards below).
implementation_mapping_to_verified_core.discarded_intermediate: An earlier hand-rolled SIMD softmax compiled and ran but produced NaN. It is discarded as evidence; its numeric path is reused nowhere. The structural contract checker from that phase was kept because it is independent of numerics.

nan_guards.why_two_are_needed: Both were found by RUNNING the all-invalid case, not by review.
nan_guards.guard_1_softmax: Clamp the row max to a finite floor (-1e30). Without it an all-masked row gives exp(-inf - -inf) = exp(NaN) = NaN.
nan_guards.guard_2_normalise: Divide by (l + 1e-30) instead of l. Clamping the max alone still leaves the final normalisation as 0/0 = NaN. For a valid row l is order 1 so 1e-30 cannot move the quotient; for an all-invalid row the numerator is already 0, so 0/(0+eps) = 0 exactly. Verified: max_abs exactly 0.000e+00.

pinned_constraints: head_dim == 128 (pre-existing SIMD packing limit of the base kernel, not introduced here).
BC == 128 == 2*VL; padding must be uniform across KV blocks because the Bias buffer ABI is (BC,), not (kv_len,). A per-position mask would need a different ABI and is NOT claimed.
Pinned shape is recorded in MixedKernelSpec.metadata next to the device claim so the two cannot drift apart.
not_claimed: Physical sufficiency of flag placement: cross-core synchronisation here is COMPILER-DERIVED from the dual_copy dataflow, not hand-emitted. No claim is made that any particular flag id is set.
Generality beyond head_dim == 128 and block-aligned padding.
Formal proof over all inputs: correctness is demonstrated by numerical comparison against torch SDPA on the listed cases.
